SQL Server Express
18 Tables (Ingredients, Recipes, StockTx)
JWT Bearer Auth + Role Claims + CORS AllowCredentials
12 API Controllers (+ InventoryController, Analytics/CSV, QR Self-Order)
Services (PBKDF2 PasswordHasher, JwtTokenService, EmailService SMTP, Helper IO)
EF Core 10 + RestaurantPosContext (18 DbSets, BOM ACID Tx)
UI Layer (Role Nav + AdminInventory + Charts + Split/Merge + QR Guest)
Repositories (JWT Auth + Inventory + Analytics + Idempotency UUID)
